name: Database Systems Engineer
description: Build database engines, query processors, and storage systems. Implement B-trees, hash indexes, transaction logs, and SQL parsers.
example_snippet:
program BTreeNode:
    shape Node holds:
        Keys as whole number with values
        Children as raw handle to Node
        IsLeaf as truth value
        KeyCount as whole number

        method insert takes Key as whole number produces nothing:
            put Key into Index at KeyCount of Keys
            put the sum of KeyCount and 1 into KeyCount
        end method
    end shape

    keep Root as unique handle to Node with new Node with nothing and nothing and true and 0
    call Root.insert with 42
    print the text "Inserted 42" and newline
end program
